comparison.objective: Select fine tweezers, peel display film through a narrow slot, and return tools.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool selection, narrow-slot tab grasping, peeling, carrier restraint, and tool return.
comparison.success_condition: All 115 mm peeled in 5 mm increments, carrier controlled, film laid aside, and both tools returned.
comparison.reason: Fine-tool peeling and carrier restraint differ from screw/nut countertorque and cyclic retention.
